name: branch-housekeeping
description: Weekly remote-branch sweep across the configured Umbraco MCP repos. Classifies every non-protected branch by its GitHub PR state — the authoritative signal, since squash merges make git ancestry lie — and posts a digest: merged leftovers to reap, ambiguous branches (closed-unmerged / no PR) for a human to judge, open-PR branches kept silently. Also flags any repo whose 'Automatically delete head branches' setting is off, since that setting is what keeps merged branches from accumulating in the first place. Report-only by default; GitHub work goes through github-ops, so it needs no token and runs as a cloud routine.
